newsitem.title: USA: Horace Mann estimates Hurricane Fran claims.
newsitem.headline: Horace Mann estimates Hurricane Fran claims.

text.p: Horace Mann Educators Corp on Tuesday estimated its policyholder claims from Hurricane Fran at $4.6 million after tax, or $0.20 per share.
For the full third quarter, it estimates its catastrophe- related claims to be nearly $6 million after tax, compared with $1.5 million during the same 1995 period.
Projecting a normal level of catastrophe-related claims for fourth quarter 1996, the company estimates full year 1996 catastrophe claims will be $0.20 to $0.25 per hare higher than the prior year.
Horace Mann sells retirement annuities and automobile, homeowners and life insurance to the nation's educators through 950 agents.
Industrywide hurricane-related insurance insured losses are estimated by the industry at $1.6 billion, more than double original projections, Horace Mann said.
